q: Do greenwashing rules apply to a LinkedIn post about our carbon footprint?
title: Carbon claims in social media posts
short: Treat them as if they do. A company post promoting its products or credentials is communication to customers, and India's 2024 greenwashing guidelines expect environmental claims to be specific and backed by evidence. Post the figure, the year and the scope, and link to where the method is explained.

ul: Our 2025-26 Scope 1 and 2 emissions were 420 t CO2e, from our fuel invoices and electricity bills.
Link to a page with the method and data sources.
We are now a green company.
Carbon neutral factory, without retired credits and full scope.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure behind a claim traceable to the invoices and bills it came from, so a reader can check the number rather than take the wording on trust.

sources.label: ISO 14021, Environmental labels and declarations: self-declared claims (iso.org)
